cards.Dictionary Meaning (English): The fundamental, ineffable principle underlying the universe and all phenomena. It is the source of all things and cannot be fully expressed in words.
cards.Nuance (English): Implies a transcendent, unnameable reality that is the foundation of existence.
cards.Sentence Translations (English): The Way that can be spoken of is not the eternal Way; the name that can be named is not the eternal name;
cards.Sentences: S道可道，非常道，名可名，非常名；

cards.Dictionary Meaning (English): A physical or metaphorical route taken by a person or thing.
cards.Nuance (English): May imply a journey or direction, but not the metaphysical sense.
cards.Sentence Translations (English): The path is distant and cannot be reached.|Walking along the road, one will not be lost.|This road is open and accessible; one should advance quickly.|The mountain path is dangerous; travelers must be cautious.
cards.Sentences: 道遠，不可至也。|行於道，則無迷。|此道通達，宜速進。|山道險峻，行者慎之。
